Rugby League World Cup: England draft Jez Litten and Morgan Knowles into starting line-up for crunch Papua New Guinea match
Brian McDermott has opted to bring Jez Litten and Morgan Knowles into his starting line-up for England's crunch Rugby League World Cup clash against Papua New Guinea on Friday; Brad O'Neill drops out of the matchday squad
Tuesday 27 October 2026 07:55, UK
Jez Litten and Morgan Knowles have been drafted into England's starting line-up for their crunch Rugby League World Cup clash against Papua New Guinea on Friday.
Brad O'Neill drops out of the 19-player matchday squad after featuring in England's 82-0 victory against France on Saturday.
Brian McDermott's side must secure victory in their final Group B and C match to keep their hopes of reaching the semi-finals alive. They will then face a nervous two-day wait for Tonga's clash against Samoa.

If Samoa win, England will be knocked out of the Rugby League World Cup at the group stage for the first time in history due to their head-to-head record against Tonga.
Tonga are guaranteed to finish above England, having won two games, including their 30-12 win against McDermott's side in their tournament opener.
But England can advance on points difference if they beat Papua New Guinea by a large margin and Tonga secure a convincing victory against Samoa.
Litten will take over from O'Neill at hooker for his first start in the tournament, while Knowels will play as England's loose forward, after missing England's first two matches due to injury.
Victor Radley, who wore the No 13 jersey against France, has dropped to the bench.
Litten, who started as an interchange during England's match against France, came on to score in the 58th minute, while Herbie Farnworth, who scored a hat-trick of tries, keeps his place in the centres alongside Hugo Savala.
England starting line-up vs Papua New Guinea:
- AJ Brimson
- Dom Young
- Hugo Savala
- Herbie Farnworth
- Matty Ashton
- George Williams
- Harry Smith
- Max King
- Jez Litten
- Luke Thompson
- Junior Nsemba
- Kai Pearce-Paul
- Morgan Knowles
Interchange: 14. Mikey Lewis; 15. Sam Walters; 16. Ethan Havard; 17. Victor Radley; 18. Ben Currie; 19. Jack Welsby; 20. Brad O'Neill; 21. Zach Eckersley; 22. Kallum Watkins.
digest_he: מאמן נבחרת אנגליה ברוגבי, בריאן מקדרמוט, החליט לבצע שינויים בסגל הפותח לקראת משחק הקבוצה בגביע העולם מול פפואה גינאה. ג'ז ליטן ומורגן נולס צורפו להרכב הראשון, בעוד שבראד או'ניל הודח מסגל 19 השחקנים. הנבחרת האנגלית חייבת לרשום ניצחון במשחקה האחרון בשלב הבתים כדי לשמור על סיכוייה להעפיל לחצי הגמר, ולאחר מכן להמתין בדריכות למשחק בין טונגה לסמואה. ליטן יפתח בעמדת ההוקר במקומו של או'ניל, ונולס יחזור לשחק בתפקיד הלואו פוורו לאחר שהחמיץ את שני המשחקים הראשונים עקב פציעה. הפסד אפשרי תלוי גם בהפרש הנקודות מול יריבותיה בבית.
